notes: 008932B0 and 00894850: each listing stops inside the epilogue (pop r15 / pop r13) at its extent end, so no ret is shown; the rows state the value left in eax (008932B0) or the path returns as listed. 008955A0: the constant at 01CEBD40 is decoded by the listing as f32x4 [0, 2, 0, 2]; it is used by mulpd, so each 8-byte lane (0x4000000000000000) reads as the double 2.0, as the sentence says. 00890A70 / 00890B00: the tail jumps reuse the caller's fifth stack slot (seventh argument, or 00883C70); the sixth slot keeps the original count. Long bodies (00890B70, 00890ED0, 00891F40, 00894850) are stated as top-level structure in clauses (rule 5); per-instruction detail such as the SSE alignment checks is summarised. No row names a library routine: the listings carry no strings, only constants.
